relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: the meta-analysis showed no statistically significant effect in cCH (OR = 1.07, 95% CI = 0.78-1.48, p = 0.68)

key_findings: Meta-analysis of RCTs: anti-CGRP mAbs beneficial in episodic CH (OR 1.65, p=0.02).
No significant effect in chronic CH (OR 1.07).
